title: MPESB MP Police Constable General Duty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7500 Posts

shortDescription: MPESB MP Police Constable GD Recruitment 2026 notification released for 7500 posts. Online applications are scheduled from 22 September 2026 to 06 October 2026.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for MP Police Constable GD Recruitment Test 2026. Eligible candidates can apply online for 7500 Constable GD vacancies.

Important dates

  • Application begins: 22 September 2026
  • Last date to apply and pay fee: 06 October 2026
  • Correction last date: 11 October 2026
  • Examination starts: 19 November 2026
  • Admit card: Before the examination
  • Answer key and result: To be notified

Vacancy and eligibility

The recruitment includes 6800 Constable GD posts and 700 Constable GD Special Armed Force posts for male candidates. Applicants generally need to pass Class 10th from a recognized board; ST candidates may apply with Class 8th qualification. Physical standards include a minimum height of 168 cm for male candidates and 155 cm for female candidates. Male chest requirements and PET details are given in the rulebook.

How to apply

Apply through the official MPESB or MPOnline portal during the application period. Read the rulebook, complete the form, upload the required documents, pay the fee and keep a printout of the submitted application.
